claims.claim: Under the S1 contract, relation traversal can be expressed by object-language recursion over stored relation data without a dedicated relation-lookup primitive.
claims.scope: finite five-entry relation; CEK-style interpreter; one recursive scan program
limits: does not establish that the current canonical Machine implementation has the same contract

claims.claim: The S1 object-language scan and S2 direct indexed lookup returned identical observed values for the tested query set.
limits: exact representation and semantics are local to this interpreter

claims.claim: In the tested interpreter, direct indexed lookup used fewer online transition/access ticks than object-language scanning, while index construction/storage were charged separately.
limits: pre-index construction is a separate offline representation cost

claims.claim: This interpreter demonstrates a candidate concrete S1/S2 substrate contract, but does not establish that the canonical Machine interpreter already implements S1 or S2.
claims.scope: repository currently lacks the canonical interpreter implementation on the inspected branches
claims.next_discriminating_test: Reconcile this experimental substrate with the actual canonical Machine interpreter source before promoting its contract.
